description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for Task operations in the API, including creation, updating, and retrieval of task data.

classes.name: TaskCreateDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new task, includes Title, optional Description, DueDate, and AssignedToUserId.

classes.name: TaskUpdateDto
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing task, includes Title, optional Description, Status (required), DueDate, and AssignedToUserId.

classes.name: TaskDto
classes.description: DTO representing task data, including Id, Title, optional Description, Status, DueDate, AssignedToUserId, AssignedToUsername, CreatedAt, and UpdatedAt.
